mostWorthwhile.text: Checking the cleaned address against the handset was most worthwhile: it revealed that the system excluded a correctly read address, making the infrastructure problem concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Removing the old caster before installing the replacement was clear once shown, but that repair sequence was less interesting than the directory discovery.

surprise.text: The handset read the address correctly but rejected it because it was absent from the active directory; the impending migration raised the stakes.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. My initial attempts to install the caster and check the muddy plate needed preparatory work, which the compatibility feedback made clear.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see how the neighbors address the directory exclusion, especially after the receipt exposed the contradiction.
